name: Default Input Set
input_set_yaml:
inputSet:
  identifier: default_input_set
  pipeline:
    identifier: Build_And_Deploy
    stages:
      - stage:
          identifier: Build
          spec:
            execution:
              steps:
                - step:
                    identifier: Compile
                    spec:
                      envVariables:
                        ENV: prod

name: Staging Input Set
input_set_yaml:
inputSet:
  identifier: staging_input_set
  pipeline:
    identifier: Build_And_Deploy
    stages:
      - stage:
          identifier: Deploy_to_Prod
          spec:
            environment: staging
